title: POWER-UPS END WHEN YOU DIE IN THE 2 PLAYER DEMO
why: Cloud robustness hunt. pwrTick clears the timed power-ups when the player is dying, with the comment that going down for good clears them, but pwrTick runs from updatePlayer, which the death beat never calls, and arcadeRespawn sets dying back to false on the same raid. So the clear never ran: in the 2 player DEMO a player who died came back with bottomless clip, double damage, rapid fire, magnet and the shield bubble still running. Proven in headless Chromium on v27.27: clip 20 s and shield 10 s set, killPlayer, 80 frames later the player is back (dying false, deaths 1) with clip 17.5 and shield 7.5 still on. Now arcadeDied clears them just before the respawn, which is what the existing line meant. CAREER and the 1 player DEMO end the run on a death, so they are unchanged.
now: In the 2 player DEMO a power-up you hold now ends when you die, so you come back without it.
